system.description:
In order to cast this spell, you must sprinkle a powdered diamond on the target.

Choose one creature in range that is currently under the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.spells.Item.ClcdWDlouhR7vIAW]{dominate}, @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.spells.Item.SGtp7RCdOaElBAoL]{feeblemind}, or @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.spells.Item.1ZAZQsFvPBEZPkVP]{polymorph} spell you have cast. The duration of that spell becomes 1 year.
